Main CI was red since 608ea9a (#505): the browser test 'My address is right sends it as typed' failed. Cause: the first day of the booking list had one free time, and the test before it had booked it. Opened P0 'Fix main' #510; made each test book its own day (fillForm takes the day index). Reproduced locally (failed before, passed 2 of 2 runs after). PR #512 merged after quick CI green. Next: the haiku lane has one ticket per run, so #507 and #508 wait for the next run. Main's browser job on the fix commit still needs a check.
